requirements.text: Voice recording with live waveform view while recording
Recording survives a phone call interruption and finalizes/resumes without corruption or data loss
Recording survives a Siri invocation interruption and finalizes/resumes without corruption or data loss
Recording survives app backgrounding and finalizes/resumes without corruption or data loss
Recording survives a force-quit via app switcher during active recording without corrupting the in-progress entry
Recording survives a route change (e.g. headphone/AirPods disconnect) without silent clipping/corruption

Interruption handling is implemented as an explicit reentrant state machine (idle/recording/interrupted/finalizing), not a boolean flag, and treats .interruption and .routeChange as distinct event types
Transcription uses on-device Speech recognition only; never falls back to server-based recognition
When on-device recognition is unsupported for the current locale/device, recording stays enabled and an explicit 'unavailable' state is shown
Transcription status model has three distinct states: ready / on-device model downloading / unavailable
Transcript text is editable after the fact
Tapping a transcript sentence seeks the audio to that point, resolved via immutable anchor ID never raw string/character index
Transcript anchors are immutable once created; user edits are represented as overlay deltas on top of the anchor set
Tap-to-seek resolves correctly (<=300ms tolerance) after a transcript text edit
If an edit deletes or fully spans an anchor, a tap near that former location resolves to the nearest surviving anchor rather than no-op or crash
NaturalLanguage-based tag suggestions are generated per transcript
NaturalLanguage-based mood/sentiment score is generated per transcript and presented as a hedged rough polarity signal, never clinical framing
Tag and mood suggestions are editable and dismissible; never silently applied as fact
A PencilKit sketch (finger or Pencil) can be attached to any entry
Sketches are stored alongside the entry's audio/transcript in the same record
Free tier caps sketches at one per entry; Fieldnotes Pro allows unlimited sketches
Entries support @-mention autocomplete to link to another entry
Mentions/backlinks resolve via the target entry's persistent UUID, never by matching display-title text
Renaming an entry never breaks or misdirects any existing mention of it
Backlinks ('linked from') are computed live from the local store on every view, never stored as a separately maintained table
Deleting an entry leaves zero dangling or duplicate backlinks in any live backlink query
A forward @-mention pointing at a since-deleted entry renders as a visually distinct 'broken link' indicator rather than silently becoming plain text
Duplicate @-mentions of the same target entry within one transcript collapse to a single backlink entry
Self-mentions are disallowed at autocomplete time
Demo entries and real entries are mutually unlinkable via @-mention autocomplete filtering by demo/real status
Full-text search spans transcripts, tags, and mood
Search results are ranked by a documented, deterministic relevance formula, not substring match order
The relevance formula produces the documented ordering on a fixed two-entry test case
Entries without a transcript yet remain findable via tags/mood/sketch metadata (documented expected behavior, not a defect)
HealthKit read-only correlation shows an entry's mood alongside that day's sleep/activity summary when authorized
HealthKit denial/no-data state is shown as a hedged 'no data available', never a confident 'not connected' claim
Core journaling is never blocked by HealthKit permission state
HealthKit data is never persisted into SwiftData at rest; only queried live per-view
Home-screen widget shows the latest entry's mood/snippet
WidgetCenter.reloadTimelines fires only on confirmed entry save, never speculatively
Live Activity shows elapsed time and a live waveform while actively recording
Live Activity ends cleanly when the recording stops
Live Activity does not orphan after a force-quit, within the documented residual-window caveat (staleDate + relaunch reconciliation)
Share Extension accepts shared text or a photo from another app and creates a new Fieldnotes entry
Widget, Live Activity, Share Extension, and App Intents all read/write the same local store as the main app via an App Group + shared SwiftData container
An App Intent exposes 'Start a voice entry' to Shortcuts/Siri
An App Intent exposes 'Search my journal' to Shortcuts/Siri
CarPlay scene code path implements hands-free start/stop recording UI wired to the shared recording engine
CarPlay is documented as an explicit Gap (cannot run without the CarPlay audio-app entitlement on a free developer account), not omitted or claimed working
All durations use TimeInterval/Double and all counts use Int; no Decimal type is used anywhere in the app
A Settings toggle seeds realistic demo entries with sample transcripts, tags, and backlinks
The demo-entries toggle is fully reversible and never partially applies
Demo entries are visually and data-model distinct from real entries at all times
Demo seed data includes at least one HealthKit-correlated day
Demo seed data includes at least one broken-link example (mention pointing at a deleted entry)
Fieldnotes Pro unlocks on-device Insights (mood trend, tag frequency, recording cadence)
Fieldnotes Pro unlocks advanced search (saved searches, compound tag+mood+date filters, search history)
Fieldnotes Pro unlocks unlimited sketches and extra app icons/themes
Pro subscription state never gates any of the 11 numbered core features or a user's own recorded data
Subscription entitlement is checked locally via Transaction.currentEntitlements after one purchase-time StoreKit round-trip; verified by a cold airplane-mode-after-purchase test
On Pro lapse, Insights/advanced search grey out with an explanation while core data and base search remain fully functional
Share-as-card export sends only mood, tags, and a short snippet to the system share sheet — never full transcript or audio
A CloudKit-ready off-by-default Settings toggle exists, documented as a named Gap with concrete steps to enable it
Microphone authorization and Speech authorization are tracked and reported as two independent permission states, with the full combination matrix in the feature health card
Audio, transcript, and sketch files in the App Group container use NSFileProtectionCompleteUntilFirstUserAuthentication at minimum
Every permission-gated feature is verified by actually toggling the permission off, not by code inspection alone
Every numbered requirement is reported with a guaranteed/degrades/gapped status plus supporting evidence (feature health card)
Every core feature works fully offline / in airplane mode
No cloud sync, accounts, server processing, analytics, telemetry, or third-party SDKs exist beyond the narrowly-scoped Pro subscription and off-by-default CloudKit toggle carve-outs
Information architecture is exactly three tabs (Timeline, Search, Settings) plus a pushed Entry Detail screen; no separate graph-visualization screen exists
